baseline_models.mechanism: The possessive service relation assigns allegiance to God, while categorical negation removes the addressee's coercive power over that relation.

activation_trace.role: Submissive obedience supplies the literal service relation and locates allegiance with God rather than the addressee.
Present-state negation removes authority as an existing relation rather than merely predicting its eventual defeat.
Overpowering coercion names the literal capacity denied and functions as the boundary around the servants.

changed_reading.before: The addressee may generally command people but cannot overpower a protected subgroup.
changed_reading.after: The servants' allegiance is already assigned to God, so the addressee has no coercive jurisdiction by which to take command of them.

baseline_models.focus_anchor: سُلْطَانٌ paired with عِبَادِي and وَكِيلًا
baseline_models.mechanism: The denial reaches beyond force to a binding proof or title: neither ownership nor a compelling claim transfers the servants from God's custody.

activation_trace.role: Owned servitude supplies the literal master-servant relation and makes rival title the issue.
A compelling proof supplies the evidentiary sense and functions as the absent basis for any rival claim.
Ownership and sovereignty identify the Lord as the party with the valid custodial title.
The one who sufficiently handles and preserves an entrusted matter supplies the operative custody that defeats rival mastery.

changed_reading.before: The verse promises only that Satan cannot physically overpower the servants.
changed_reading.after: Satan lacks both coercive force and any binding proof, title, or custodial standing over those already held and handled by their Lord.

baseline_models.mechanism: Sufficiency is dynamic: a mapped restraint image checks intrusion, while lordship forms and repairs and agency preserves the entrusted matter.

activation_trace.role: The mapped image of checking and preventing gives sufficiency an active restraining edge against intrusion.
Repair, nurture, and completion supply ongoing formation and make protection developmental rather than merely defensive.
Sufficient handling and preservation supply the custodial action that joins restraint to care.

changed_reading.before: The Lord is enough as a fallback protector after danger appears.
changed_reading.after: The Lord's sufficiency is an active boundary and a continuing work of forming, handling, and preserving the servants.

context_deltas.mechanism: The preceding sequence distinguishes a wide attack surface from sovereignty: followership, destabilization, audible appeal, mobilization, participation, hopeful promises, and deceptive shine can operate without becoming coercive jurisdiction.

activation_trace.role: Overpowering coercion supplies the denied endpoint against which the preceding tactics are measured.
Loyal succession supplies the follower's affiliating act and functions as the uptake through which inducement becomes alignment.
Lightness that shakes stability supplies the literal disturbance and functions as an attempt to loosen settled allegiance.
Audible voice supplies a communicative channel and functions as appeal rather than compulsion.
Clamor and gathering supply mobilized pressure and function as amplification without conferring rule.
Participation supplies entry into wealth and offspring and functions as invasive involvement short of ownership.
A spoken promise that opens hope supplies prospective attraction and functions as voluntary inducement.
A glitter that deceives but does not endure supplies the promise's mechanism and marks its lack of binding substance.

structural_cues: 17:63 conditions the outcome on whoever follows; 17:64 then enumerates imperatives of influence immediately before 17:65 categorically denies authority.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies followership plus several channels of pressure; I infer that their effectiveness requires uptake and does not itself create coercive rule. A live alternative is that سُلْطَان denies only force while leaving the degree of noncoercive influence unspecified.

changed_reading.before: No authority means Satan cannot meaningfully affect God's servants.
changed_reading.after: He can agitate, address, recruit, participate, and promise, but these tactics require followership and never become coercive jurisdiction.

context_deltas.mechanism: The context joins low obedient posture to bestowed honor: service to God is not degraded possession but a dignified allegiance that Satan's prestige-based refusal cannot overrule.

activation_trace.role: Humble obedience supplies the servants' allegiance and links them to the prostration scene.
Honor and magnification supply a second live image within servanthood and prevent humility from meaning worthlessness.
Lowering oneself supplies the embodied obedience accepted by the angels and contested by Iblis.
Praised honor supplies the status Iblis resents and functions as the motive for his attempted re-ranking.
Praised honor extends to Adam's children and functions as contextual confirmation that dependence and dignity coexist.

structural_cues: Iblis's refusal follows the command to bow to Adam, his threat targets Adam's descendants, and 17:70 repeats their divine honoring.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies obedient lowering and repeated honoring; I infer that the focus designation holds humility and dignity together and blocks Iblis's rival status judgment. The alternative is that عِبَادِي marks a narrower devotional subset without importing the honor of all Adam's children.

changed_reading.before: The servants are protected chiefly as subordinated dependents.
changed_reading.after: Their dependence is dignified allegiance: Satan's lack of authority also defeats his attempt to rank God's honored servants beneath himself.

context_deltas.mechanism: The Lord's agency becomes concrete movement, rescue, carrying, and provision across unstable space; the later inability to find any agent against divine threat makes that agency exclusive, not a guarantee against the Lord's own judgment.

activation_trace.role: Sufficient handling and preservation supply the focus claim and function as the controlling agency in the sequence.
Gentle propulsion supplies concrete guidance of the vessel and makes divine handling kinetic.
The ship moving in water supplies the entrusted vehicle through which guardianship operates.
Release by separation supplies rescue from danger and functions as a decisive act of the sole agent.
Heart-set security supplies the challenged assumption and exposes false inference from protection to immunity.
The earth's sinking supplies a threat from the Lord's domain and prevents guardianship from being read as exemption from judgment.
The same preserving agent is explicitly unavailable as an alternative under divine threat, making agency exclusive rather than interchangeable.
Bearing a visible load supplies sustained conveyance and extends agency beyond emergency rescue.
Apportioned provision supplies material care and completes the operational profile of guardianship.

structural_cues: 17:66-67 move from conveyance to distress and rescue; 17:68 denies finding a وَكِيل against the same Lord; 17:70 resumes carrying and provision.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies divine propulsion, rescue, threat, absent alternative agency, carrying, and provision; I infer that 17:65 denies rival Satanic custody while retaining God's sovereign exposure of people to judgment. The alternative is to read the hazard sequence only as a separate warning about ingratitude.

changed_reading.before: God's agency guarantees that His servants avoid danger.
changed_reading.after: God alone manages passage through danger and may rescue, carry, and provision, but His agency does not immunize anyone from His judgment; the rival custody denied in 17:65 is Satan's.

context_deltas.mechanism: The denied compelling proof becomes legal standing: no claimant can proceed against God, while final affiliation, binding record, public reading, and exact justice remain with divine adjudication.

activation_trace.role: A compelling proof supplies the focus's evidentiary register and functions as the standing Satan lacks.
A claimant pursuing a right supplies the legal counterimage and is explicitly unavailable against God.
A leader who is followed supplies declared affiliation and routes each group into judgment.
A written fixation that entails judgment supplies the binding record and displaces Satanic allegation.
Reading and recitation supply inspectable disclosure of the record rather than hidden accusation.
Withholding a right supplies the injustice explicitly negated and makes divine adjudication exact.
The minute fiber supplies the scale at which no right is diminished.

structural_cues: 17:69 denies any pursuing claimant against God; 17:71 calls groups by their leaders, has them read their records, and denies even minute injustice.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies absent claimant, affiliation, binding record, disclosure, and exact justice; I infer that Satan's absent سُلْطَان includes no evidentiary standing to claim the servants. The alternative is that the proof branch is secondary and the focus denies coercive power alone.

changed_reading.before: Protection means the servants are simply outside hostile power.
changed_reading.after: They remain fully accountable, but Satan has no standing or binding evidence by which to own their case; adjudication belongs to God and the disclosed record.

context_deltas.mechanism: The addressee can approach inclination under relational pressure, yet explicit divine stabilization prevents the near-act from becoming transferred allegiance; guardianship works at the threshold rather than erasing vulnerability or responsibility.

activation_trace.role: Complete handling of the matter supplies sufficient divine intervention at the point of vulnerability.
Preserving agency supplies the focus anchor and functions as the source of stabilization.
Inclination away from truth supplies the attempted directional change against which guardianship acts.
Affection entering the self supplies the offered intimacy and functions as relational leverage.
Approach to an act supplies a real but unrealized threshold and blocks a reading of invulnerability.
Strengthening something into stability supplies the explicit divine action that arrests the near-leaning.
Inclination and repose toward another supply the transfer of reliance that stabilization prevents.
Aid and vindication supply the helper absent in the counterfactual and preserve accountability within protection.

structural_cues: Paired كاد clauses move from their near-success in 17:73 to your near-leaning in 17:74; لولا attributes the non-event to explicit divine stabilization, and 17:75 supplies the counterfactual consequence.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies attempted inclination, offered intimacy, near-leaning, explicit stabilization, and absent aid in the counterfactual; I infer that stabilization causes the threshold not to be crossed. A live alternative is that this is special prophetic support rather than a general mechanism for all servants.

changed_reading.before: No Satanic authority means a protected servant never comes close to yielding.
changed_reading.after: A protected servant may reach a genuine threshold of inclination; the Lord's agency appears as stabilization before allegiance transfers, without canceling responsibility.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: This is surprising because it activates the rare oil-light branch of سُلْطَان across the nearby deceptive shine, blindness, and path sequence. It remains anchored in the exact focus branch and coherent visual cues, but downstream prose should present it only as a secondary imagistic echo, not claim that سُلْطَان lexically means lamp here.

activation_trace.role: Illuminating oil supplies the rare focus image and casts authority as a claimed source of light.
Deceptive glitter that fails to endure supplies the false luminosity of Satanic promise.
Blindness of insight supplies the condition that false illumination cannot cure.
A traversable extended path supplies the route on which genuine illumination would have to guide.

changed_reading.before: سُلْطَان names only authority or proof.
changed_reading.after: Exploratorily, its oil-light branch also images Satan as no trustworthy illuminant over the servants: his promise glitters, but it leaves the path blind.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: This is surprising because the rare little-lingering and quick-motion branch is far from the ordinary plural عِبَاد. It remains worth carrying because 17:76 reproduces the little-lingering image with unusual precision and 17:77 regularizes the reversal, but downstream prose should label it a latent kinetic echo rather than a gloss of عِبَادِي.
surprising_valid_outliers.focus_anchor: عِبَادِي, through the rare little-lingering and quick-motion branch

activation_trace.role: Little lingering and quick motion supply the rare focus image and turn a static identity into a kinetic pivot.
Remaining in a place supplies the exact duration image that is then curtailed.
Smallness supplies the brief measure of hostile tenure after attempted displacement.
A recurrent governing path supplies the regularity that turns brief tenure into patterned reversal.

changed_reading.before: My servants is a static protected identity.
changed_reading.after: Exploratorily, the rare branch makes that identity a pivot of quick reversal: attempted removal of the servant is followed by only brief hostile tenure.

strongest_changes: The attack inventory separates noisy inducement that requires followership from coercive or evidentiary authority.
Divine agency becomes active conveyance, rescue, provision, and stabilization while remaining exclusive and compatible with divine judgment.
The servants remain accountable, but Satan lacks title, proof, or standing over their case; their humble allegiance is also dignified.
summary.what_was_special: The immediate sequence names an unusually broad attack surface before denying authority, then repeats وَكِيل in a no-alternative threat and pairs near-leaning with explicit stabilization. Rare mapped branches also opened contained light and brief-lingering echoes.
remaining_uncertainties: Whether the compelling-proof sense of سُلْطَان is fully co-active with coercive power or only a secondary legal resonance.
Whether the honor of Adam and his children directly characterizes the narrower phrase عِبَادِي.
The light and brief-lingering outliers are branch-triggered imagery and should not be promoted into lexical glosses.
